newsitem.title: USA: Gamma Biologicals, Genetic Testing in pact.
newsitem.headline: Gamma Biologicals, Genetic Testing in pact.

text.p: Gamma Biologicals Inc said on Thursday Genetic Testing Institute Inc named Gamma the exclusive distributor of its enzyme-linked immunosorbant assay testing products in North America and all U.S. territories.
Genetic Testing made diagnostic products in conjunction with organ transplantation and platelet transfusion and for the diagnosis of platelet disorders, Gamma said.
In the first full year of the initial three-year contract, Gamma said it anticipated revenues in excess of $1 million.
Negotiations were under way to expand the agreement to include various South American, Asian and European countries Gamma now services, it said.
